To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) ecological management of the highway landscape is a positive contribution to landscape aesthetics, (ii) management should take into consideration the context of the highway, (iii) the visual experience should be diversified and (iv) users must be informed of the nature of the ecological management programme.
ecological management contributes positively to landscape aesthetics and that under certain conditions, it is possible to manage highway corridors to enhance their aesthetic value.
the ecological management method used in Quebec highway corridor landscapes has contributed positively to the visual experience of the landscape, but only under certain conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method of landscape monitoring, which can contribute to the management of highway landscapes.
the visual experience of the highway corridor landscape and the effects of ecological management.
the development of a method to characterize and manage the landscape of highway corridors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method used in this study was effective in providing information that can be used to improve the landscape management programme.
the new management method has a positive impact on the visual experience.
the method of ecological management used in this study has been successful in improving the landscape quality along Quebec's highway corridors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
visual landscape monitoring is a powerful tool for characterizing the visual experience of highway landscapes, and for managing them.

the methodological approach developed for this project can provide a useful tool for highway managers to monitor the impact of vegetation management on the visual experience of users and the landscape itself.
the method used for monitoring the landscape changes generated by a management method is a useful tool to assess the visual quality of highway corridors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of visual landscape monitoring as a tool can be an effective way to characterize and manage highway corridor landscapes.
the landscape can be managed to achieve both ecological and aesthetic goals.

it is possible to use landscape monitoring to evaluate the effects of management practices on the landscape, and this can provide useful information for the development of landscape management policies.
